findings.text: §3 done-when (1) puts the flux-row COCOS 3 declaration on `PlasmaSource.from_mast`, but §3's body (line 60) says "the reader declares exactly those flux rows" where "the reader" is `nova/media/sources/mast_efit.py::read_frame`, which today rescales flux by `TOTAL_FLUX_FACTOR` (verified mast_efit.py:87,116–117); the plan never states that read_frame's multiplication moves into the sourcemap declaration, so a node that adds the declaration at from_mast while leaving read_frame's `TOTAL_FLUX_FACTOR` in place applies the 2π twice and, contrary to the body's "their values are unchanged for every caller", every MAST flux row gains a factor of 2π
